problem_context.problem_description: Choose items, each with a value and a weight, to maximise the total value without exceeding the capacity.
problem_context.algorithm_approach: Randomised greedy with restarts: at each step pick among the best-scored items that still fit.
key_challenges: Items that fill the remaining capacity well
problem_context.performance_considerations: score() is called in every comparison of the sort.
problem_context.domain_knowledge: Value density is the classic greedy rule.
